q: What is the minimum order quantity?
a: Our minimum order is 100 units, making custom packaging affordable for businesses of all sizes. Volume discounts are available for larger orders.
Standard production time is 10-12 business days after artwork approval. Rush production options are available for urgent orders with additional fees.
Yes, we can provide blank samples or printed samples from previous orders to showcase material quality. Custom samples may incur a small fee.

q: What file formats do you accept for artwork?
a: We accept AI, EPS, PDF, and high-resolution PNG files. Our design team can also work with lower-quality files and recreate your artwork if needed.

q: Can I order different designs in one order?
a: Yes, you can split your order into multiple designs, though each design must meet the 100-unit minimum requirement.
We offer Gloss, Matte, and Spot UV coating options. Gloss provides vibrant colors, Matte offers a sophisticated look, and Spot UV adds raised glossy elements to specific areas.
Absolutely. All our materials are food-grade and comply with FDA and EU food contact regulations. We use only approved inks and coatings.
Yes, we ship worldwide including UK, USA, Canada, Australia, and throughout Europe. Shipping costs and delivery times vary by location.

q: Can I reorder the same design later?
a: Yes, we keep your artwork on file for easy reordering. Simply reference your previous order number when placing a new order.

q: What payment methods do you accept?
a: We accept major credit cards, bank transfers, and PayPal. Payment terms are available for established business accounts.
